rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for a person, animal, or body part visibly covered with a lot of hair or fur.

example.english: My dog is really hairy in winter.
example.traditional: 我隻狗冬天成身好多毛。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zek3 gau2 dung1 tin1 seng4 san1 hou2 do1 mou4

rows.note: Use this for a difficult, complicated problem or situation rather than one that is primarily frightening.

example.english: This customer complaint is pretty hairy.
example.jyutping: ne1 daan1 haak3 wu6 tau4 sou3 gei2 gik1 sau2

rows.note: Use this colloquial Hong Kong expression for something scary, risky, or nerve-wracking.

example.english: Walking this mountain road at night is really hairy.
example.traditional: 夜晚行呢條山路真係牙煙。
example.jyutping: je6 maan5 haang4 ne1 tiu4 saan1 lou6 zan1 hai6 ngaa4 jin1
